THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT

In this appeal, the petitioner has challenged the judgment dated 29.08.2015 passed by the M.A.C.T.,
XX Addl. Small Causes Judge, Bangalore (SCCH-22) ('the Tribunal' in short) in M.V.C.
No.5209/2013.
2.

entities.text: XX Addl. Small Causes Judge, Bangalore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: For the sake of convenience, the parties shall be referred to as per their status before the Tribunal.

3. Brief facts of the case are, on 15.06.2013 at about 11:30 am, the petitioner met with an accident near I.T.P.L. Main Road, Bangalore, hit by a Motor cycle bearing Reg.No.KA-14/Y-4587 causing him injuries.
He was hospitalized and thereafter, seeking compensation of Rs.8,00,000/-, approached the Tribunal.
Claim was opposed by the respondents.
The Tribunal after taking the evidence, by impugned judgment awarded a sum of Rs.3,25,000/-.
Pleading NC: 2023:KHC:29550 inadequacy and seeking enhancement of compensation, the petitioner has filed this appeal on various grounds.

4. Heard the arguments of Sri. Suresh.M.Latur, learned counsel for the petitioner, Sri. S.V.Hegde Mukhand, learned counsel for the Insurance Company.
5.
It is the contention of the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner has suffered fracture of right radius and ulna.
He was hospitalized for a period of 15 days.
He was a Security Guard and suffered 31% of permanent disability to right upper limb.

The Tribunal has not adequately compensated him towards loss of amenities and discomfort, pain and sufferings, so also the loss of income during laid up period and sought for enhancement of compensation.

Per contra, learned counsel for the Insurance Company has contended that towards loss of amenities and discomfort, a little enhancement may be accorded, the Tribunal by considering the relevant materials, awarded the just compensation and there is no need for further enhancement on other heads and supported the impugned judgment.
7. I have given my anxious consideration to the arguments addressed and also perused the materials on record.

sentences.text: There is no dispute as to the accident, cause of the accident and fracture of both the bones of right upper arm of the petitioner, which caused him 31% of the limb disability.
The Tribunal has assessed whole body disability at 10%.

Having regard to the nature of work that the petitioner doing as a Security Guard, having sustained injury to the right hand, he could not effectively discharge his duties and therefore, he required to be compensated NC: 2023:KHC:29550 towards loss of amenities and discomfort.

The Tribunal has considered the income of the petitioner at Rs.11,350/-
as he was drawing from his job.

The Tribunal has correctly applied the multiplier and assessed 10%
disability and awarded loss of income due to disability.

The Tribunal has awarded Rs.40,000/-
towards pain and suffering, medical expenses of Rs.5,000/-, Rs.20,000/- towards incidental expenses such as food and nourishment, attendant charges and transportation, Rs.45,000/- towards loss of income during laid-up period, Rs.2,05,000/- towards loss of income due to disability and Rs.10,000/- towards loss of amenities.
Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, the award of Rs.10,000/- towards loss of amenities in life is inadequate, so also the loss of income during laid-up period.

The petitioner was laid-up for a minimum of 5 months, which comes to Rs.56,750/- (Rs.11,350/- x 5 months) and also a sum of Rs.50,000/- towards loss of amenities and NC: 2023:KHC:29550 discomfort as against Rs.10,000/- awarded by the Tribunal and thereby, the enhancement of a sum of Rs.50,000/- globally will meet the ends of justice.

Accordingly, the appeal deserves to be allowed, in the result, the following:
ORDER i) The appeal is allowed in part.
ii) The impugned judgment is modified.

iii) The petitioner is entitled to an enhanced global compensation of Rs.50,000/-
with interest of 6% p.a.
iv) The Insurance Company is directed to deposit the amount of compensation within eight weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this judgment.
v) Amount in deposit, if any, shall be transmitted to the Tribunal along with records forthwith.
